crossRefs.note: In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits.

translations.web: In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits.
translations.bsb: And the main hall in front of this room was forty cubits long.
translations.kjv: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.
translations.asv: And the house, that is, the temple before the oracle, was forty cubits long.
